thread:
Sam (CEO): Quick post-all-hands Q&A: let's capture concrete signals on why we won vs why we lost and one near-term fix we can actually ship in 30 days. Keep replies terse.

Marco (VP Product): Win: customers loved the Dedicated performance guarantees in PoC. Loss: several prospects stalled because Private deployment docs were not checklist-ready. 30d fix: publish a Private quickstart + a one-page handoff checklist.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: hands-on kickoff and milestone-driven pilots close faster. Loss: opaque pilot billing led to churn in two pilots. 30d fix: pilot billing FAQ + sample invoice attached to kickoff pack.

Ethan (Sales): Win: customers respond to clear fallback/escape stories. Loss: we lost 3 RFPs asking for air-gapped install docs and an SOC2 excerpt. 30d fix: assemble an "RFP security packet" (SOC excerpt, KMS integration note, redacted network diagram).

Nina (Solutions): Customers repeatedly ask for a single bundle to hand to procurement. I'll draft the audit packet this week and invite CS/Legal.

Priya (Eng): Win: runtime perf on short convo flows is a win in demos. Loss: quantized long-seq regressions caused two missed SLOs in pilot. 30d fix: spec a long-seq perf smoke test and add it to canary runs (60d to implement).

Ana (Legal): Win: simple contracts help velocity. Loss: customers want example pilot liability language. 60d fix: produce a pilot contract appendix template legal-approved.

Leah (Customer Success): Also note: onboarding docs need an ops checklist for certs/certs rotation for Private. 30d fix: ops runbook snippet + common checklist.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks: owners for each 30d item by EOD tomorrow and one KPI we can track (pilot cycle time, RFP security conversion, long-seq p95).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-9998: "Private quickstart + RFP security packet" assigned to Marco + Nina, due in 30 days.

Ethan (Sales): I'll DM Leah the 3 RFPs that asked for air-gap docs. Also drafting a 1-page AE rebuttal card for billing + air-gap.

Priya (Eng): Tagging eng-runtime and eng-infra for the smoke-test spec. Will post short doc in eng-runtime channel.

Nina (Solutions): I'll start the audit packet Google doc and invite CS/Legal/Sales.

Marco (VP Product): I'll own the Private quickstart deliverable. Leah/Nina/Ana please sync so I can convert to tickets.

Sam (CEO): Good. If there's a blocker to owners, escalate to me. We'll review owners + KPIs in next leadership sync. :eyes:
